No. If you waive the weather hold, DOA claims for cold or heat damage in transit are not accepted, so a plant damaged by freezing wouldn't be covered. The Plant Care Guarantee would still apply to other problems, but not cold or heat damage in transit.

If you'd rather stay protected, you can leave the hold in place. Plants may then be held up to 7 days, and we'll email you. A free heat pack can be added at checkout in winter, but I don't have details on adding one to an existing order, so I can escalate that to a Support Lead if you'd like.
